Destinations / Goa

Goa

Palm-fringed beaches, Portuguese lanes and sunset shacks

Best time: November – March. Short drives, calm beaches in the south and plenty of family-friendly campsites.

Highlights

  • Quiet southern beaches like Agonda and Palolem
  • Old Goa churches (UNESCO)
  • Dudhsagar waterfalls
  • Fontainhas Latin quarter

Suggested road trips

North to South coastal crawl

5 days · about 140 km. Arambol → Anjuna → Panjim → Colva → Agonda → Palolem, one beach at a time.

  1. Arambol → Anjuna (20 km, about 1 h)
  2. Anjuna → Panjim (20 km, about 1 h)
  3. Panjim → Colva (35 km, about 1.5 h)
  4. Colva → Agonda (45 km, about 1.5 h)
  5. Agonda → Palolem (10 km, about 0.5 h)

Goa hinterland & waterfalls

3 days · about 180 km. Spice farms of Ponda, Dudhsagar falls and Netravali forest.

Before you go

Sea level.

Pumps in every town.

Narrow village roads and tight parking in North Goa; heavy rain June–September. Park only where allowed — overnight parking on beaches is not permitted.
